title: Owner names through a null-safe lambda chain

blocks.text: Null checks need not break a lambda chain apart: `filter(Objects::nonNull)` drops missing elements, and `Optional.ofNullable(...).map(...).orElse(...)` walks a path where any step may be missing.

The file declares `record Owner(String name)` and `record Item(String id, Owner owner)`. Write `static List<String> ownerNames(List<Item> items)` in `OwnerNames`: for each item, in order, its owner's name, or `"Unknown"` when there is no name to give. `null` items are left out.
"No name to give" can happen at more than one step of the path.

cases.says: Each item gives its owner's name, in order.
A null item is dropped from the result instead of throwing.
An item with no owner gives "Unknown" instead of throwing.
An owner whose name is null also gives "Unknown", never null.

concepts: filter(Objects::nonNull) and Optional.ofNullable keep null handling inside a lambda chain.
